cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: There Is a Process
cards.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before I reassure you about the wedding, what precisely am I guaranteeing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Weather, marriage, or catering? They have different approval routes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One-time or renewable reassurance? I'll amend the request.

mechanism: A acts as an expert request handler, forcing a distressed wedding participant to specify emotional reassurance before authorizing it.
confusable: D182 avoids questions; D190 genuinely processes even a feeling as a request with scope and terms.
comparison: Personal reassurance and physical comfort differ from lending property during rain.
seedUse: Keep general okay narrowed to hug; make A's final classification enable a concrete next action.
